text:
maria-oncall: night handoff — quick summary before I sign off. current: embed regen elevated in eu-west1 since ~01:10UTC, KV cache miss rate up ~18%. mitigation in flight: scaled kvproxy pool + prewarm of hot prefixes. playbook updated: /playbooks/kv-prewarm (link). next steps: monitor 01:30-02:30UTC, if miss rate stays >15% escalate to infra.
lee-sre: got it. what did prewarm command look like? any noisy prefixes identified?
sam-infra: prewarm ran at 01:15 via `kubectl exec -it kv-prewarm -- /bin/prewarm --prefixes-file s3://redwood-ops/hot-prefixes.txt`. hot prefixes are mostly search/autocomplete and user-session keys. no errors in logs. CPU on kvproxy jumped 20% briefly.
maria-oncall: thanks @sam-infra. I also temporarily bumped kvproxy replicas from 6 -> 9 in eu-west1 to absorb regen. autoscaler should normalize after 15m.
opsbot: incident created (INC-2026-042) - "eu-west1 embed regen spike" — severity: P2. linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-2026-042
jordan-eng: FYI I've paused the embed-reindex job that was starting at 01:00 -- suspected contributor. job paused via airflow: `airflow dag pause embed_reindex`.
lee-sre: good call. any FDs for fallback routing if we see sustained latency?
maria-oncall: fallback routing is on: policy -> route to smaller-model-quant variant in eu-west1 if 95p latency > 1.2s for 5m. I also added a temporary circuit-break threshold at 85% success rate to avoid cascading retries.
sam-infra: quick note — increased redis client timeout on kvproxy from 120ms -> 250ms to reduce retry churn. this is in a small deploy; rollout is 30% canary.
jordan-eng: PRs to watch: PR#5423 (kvproxy timeout bump) and PR#5480 (prewarm improvements). @lee-sre can you thumb PR#5423 when you have a sec?
lee-sre: will review in 15m. if I don't land it, ping me in #eng-oncall.
maria-oncall: monitoring: dashboards updated, token-level cost not impacted yet. I'll check back at 01:40UTC and hand off to @lee-sre if unresolved. if you see the miss rate spike >25% flip the slack alert to critical and call the oncall phone.
opsbot: alert: kvcache.miss_rate (eu-west1) breached 20% at 01:24:12 UTC — value: 22.3% — triggered automation: scale kvproxy + postmortem draft created.
jordan-eng: saw that alert. I'm running a quick query to check prefix distribution: `SELECT prefix, count(*) FROM kv_access WHERE ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' GROUP BY prefix ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;` will paste results in a few.
maria-oncall: thanks all. outstanding items for next shift: 1) confirm whether paused reindex can resume safely, 2) finalize timeout PR and monitor canary, 3) evaluate if prefix prewarm list needs expanding. tagging @lee-sre to pick up at 01:40UTC. :thumbsup:
lee-sre: taking over at 01:40UTC. will also run `kvproxy metrics snapshot` and do a quick heap check on redis-03.
maria-oncall: handing off — logs and runbook links in thread, incident INC-2026-042. good night! :sleeping:
